photos.name: both-loaves-with-crumb-slice
photos.summary: Both sourdough boules cooling on counter — loaf 1 in foreground on wire rack showing cross-score pattern and golden blistered crust, loaf 2 behind. Sliced piece on white cutting board shows open crumb structure. Warm VSCO tones.

photos.name: crumb-shot-hand-held
photos.summary: Crumb shot of loaf 1 held in hand — open, airy structure with mix of medium and larger bubbles, slightly glassy translucent spots in parts. Golden crust ring visible.

photos.name: loaf1-cooling-rack-cross-score
photos.summary: Loaf 1 on copper wire cooling rack — cross-score pattern opened during oven spring, golden brown blistered crust with flour dusting from banneton. Good height and dome shape visible from slight side angle.
